verdict.rationale: Runpod documents its own storage lifecycle controls. Network volumes persist independently of compute, and data is retained when Pods terminate or scale to zero. Users can manage files on those volumes via an S3-compatible API without launching a Pod, and can manage volumes and terminate Pods via the CLI and console. That gives users direct control over what data persists and what gets removed, but the pack never explicitly addresses retention policies or deletion guarantees. missing for 10: explicit retention-period settings or policies, documented deletion guarantees (e.g. secure wipe on terminate), retention terms for Serverless/Public Endpoint request data, account-level data deletion, independent corroboration.
